methodology.implementation: Independent static application to each latest available filing as of 2026-11-02; no official index-membership claim, quarterly buffer/monitoring transition, constituent-universe replication or Yasaar approval. No switch of an existing campaign methodology.
methodology.mapping_policy: Use same-date reported carrying balances and count drawn loans, notes, commercial paper and finance leases. Exclude operating-lease liabilities, undrawn commitments, future contractual interest and fair-value debt quotations from debt. Include all cash (including restricted), deposits, conventional debt investments and identified interest-bearing financing receivables; remove cash-equivalent overlaps and separately identified equity. These are explicit research accounting choices, not unstated requirements attributed to the public rules.
methodology.income_policy: Latest reported YTD interval (annual for MU); no mixing annual interest with quarterly revenue. Count gross interest and identified positive conventional-debt returns without offsetting borrowing expense or unrelated losses. Non-compliant business revenue and investment returns require activity/instrument classification; generic hardware, games, cloud or all advertising are not automatically prohibited. Direct cinema/music, conventional insurance/finance and prohibited goods/intermediation require attribution. Unclassified revenue remains unknown.
methodology.purification_rule: Section 4.4 recommends purification at 5% of dividends received. This is not 5% of company revenue, not an eligibility override and not a complete rule for disposition/capital gains.
